source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Άτταλος ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. This is not the corpus's `attalus-of-niculitel`, who is one of the martyrs of Niculițel in Scythia Minor: saint.gr's man is a monk and a wonderworker who died in peace, and the epithet «ο Θαυματουργός» is what the day's line uses to tell him apart. The page gives no century, no country and no monastery, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. No hymn is printed.
